chunks: So, you should worship only God, and be among the grateful.
ai.seo_question: What is the core command regarding worship and gratitude in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar is often cited to emphasize that true monotheism (Tawhid) is incomplete without active gratitude (Shukr), as ingratitude is a hallmark of the disbelievers mentioned in the preceding verses. Scholars highlight that worship here is not merely ritualistic but encompasses a conscious recognition of Allah's favors, making thankfulness an integral component of servitude (Ubudiyyah).
